verdict.rationale: Intel markets Copilot+ voice-command features enabled by this chip's NPU ('Say it and Copilot+ helps do it... Use voice commands to get answers, edit content'), but this is a single marketing mention describing OS-level Copilot+ functionality rather than the chip itself being operated via natural language, with no independent or hands-on verification. Missing for 10: concrete examples of natural-language command execution, first-party technical docs on the feature, independent corroboration of reliability.
